name: alert
title: Alert
description: A message that stays until it is dealt with: what happened, what to do, an action; danger and warning are announced; dismissing folds its height away.
whenToUse: Persistent problems or notices on a page: failing webhook, expiring card, maintenance.

anatomy: alert (m-surface; tone tint composed over the role's fill)
spec.motion: Dismiss folds the height to zero and fades over --pui-duration-standard, then unmounts; reduced motion is instant. Nothing moves at rest.

scopeDefaults.precedence: Instance prop, then nearest UIRoot.defaults entry, then existing component fallback. Only presentation keys are accepted; values, callbacks and operational state remain caller-owned.

spec.appearance: className/style address the existing visual root; native ref preserves internal measurements and focus. Typed classNames addresses documented existing parts; source owns deeper anatomy.
